answer_summary: Says no neutral ranking exists; lists cyber specialists (Eskenzi, 10Fold, LaunchTech, Red Lorry Yellow Lorry) and tech firms with cyber practices (Highwire, Merritt, FischTank). Advises boutiques for early stage.

PR and AR run as one connected program: PR earns coverage, AR briefs Gartner, Forrester, IDC; align messaging, use RSAC, customer stories. 2026 notes: AI search shapes brand description, credibility beats hype. No firms recommended.

Six steps: keep SEO basics and allow AI crawlers, publish original data, structure pages for extraction, earn off-site mentions (G2, analysts, press), entity signals, track each engine. Says llms.txt and custom schema are not required.

Estimates $15K to $30K per month ($180K to $360K a year) for a Series B specialist retainer. Ranges: Series A $8K-$20K, top-tier $40K-$75K+, freelance $2K-$5K, boutique $5K-$15K. Three firms named only as premium cyber specialists.

No single best. Lists five US cyber PR firms (Merritt, W2, Highwire, FischTank, Code Red) as agencies, no individual consultants. Gives selection tips: non-US launch case studies, outlet ties, analyst relations, references.
